Name: Golden Chicken Statue
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
Tired of waiting until perfection to get golden chickens? Want a more reliable means of seeing the witch event? Look no further, because the wizard has you covered!

This mod adds a new statue to the wizard's catalogue that, when activated, forces the witch to be golden when she appears at your farm. Furthermore, by offering a galaxy soul to the statue, you can attempt to summon her to your farm!
